note: The standard sheet grids (docs/frontend/chart.md#sheet-grids). A band: [south edge, north edge, sheets, edge, first number, direction]: sheets of equal width, numbered eastward from the band's west edge (deg E) when direction is 1, westward from its east edge when -1. Checked by python/charts/build_charts.py against the quadrangle the IAU/USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature gives every named feature; the sheet names come from the same field into public/charts/index.json.
